title: Chapter 412: Ice Phoenix Emperor'S Plea
content:
Chapter 412: Ice Phoenix Emperor'S Plea

In the depths of the Great Snow Mountain.

The Ice Phoenix Emperor fell to the ground with serious injuries, and could not even stand up.

Not far away, a man stood with a sword in his hand. He looked at the ice coffin in front of him affectionately. In the ice coffin, there was a stunning woman.

The man muttered to himself: "Cai Yi, as long as you extract the power of Nirvana from the Ice Phoenix Emperor, you can be resurrected."

The Ice Phoenix Emperor on the side was horrified when she heard this. This was the first time she really felt the threat of death.

If she didn't have the power of Nirvana, could she still be called a phoenix?

"Sword God, you can't do this!!!"

The Ice Phoenix Emperor tried his best and roared hysterically.

After a fierce battle with the Sword God before, the Ice Phoenix Emperor was seriously injured, and now he was like meat on the chopping board.

The Ice Phoenix Emperor didn't want to die.

But this couldn't change the Sword God's mind.

The Sword God just made a move, and a huge formation was generated in the sky.

Then it enveloped the entire space.

The Ice Phoenix was tied up by countless rune chains. At the other end, the ice coffin slowly flew to the top of the Ice Phoenix, and a mysterious light connected the two.

The Ice Phoenix struggled violently, with endless fear in his eyes.

But it was all in vain!

Under the threat of death, no matter how ferocious the monster is, it will be afraid.

"Sword God, let me go! I am willing to be your contracted beast. As long as you don't extract my Nirvana power, I will do anything for you."

"Ice Phoenix, do you think there is anything else on you that is worth my attention?"

"If it weren't for the resurrection of my beloved, I wouldn't bother to bother you!"

"It is your great honor to provide her with the power of Nirvana! Haha..."

The formation gradually took shape, the ice coffin and the Ice Phoenix were firmly fixed, the Sword God nodded with satisfaction, and then floated away.

It would take about ten years to completely extract the Nirvana power of the Ice Phoenix.

...

Wang Shuo walked through the long ice crack passage and accidentally came to the formation where the Ice Phoenix was imprisoned.

The Ice Phoenix, who was in despair, was so excited that she wanted to cry, and instantly ignited her desire for life.

This place is located deep in the Great Snow Mountain, and it can be said that there are few people.

It is almost impossible for anyone to find it.

The appearance of this person in front of her gave her hope to escape from this place.

"Human, can you save me?"

Under the threat of death, the Ice Phoenix also put down her pride and asked for help.

Wang Shuo ignored the big white bird, but just kept looking at the magical scene in front of him and praised it.

This kind of formation was also the first time Wang Shuo had seen it.

The surging power was palpitating.

"Human, what is your name? I can be your contracted beast."

The Ice Phoenix directly threw out a huge temptation.

The Ice Phoenix thought about it, and the human in front of him was still too weak to break the formation.

Moreover, even if he left the formation, the Sword God would find him through his breath. It would be better to become someone else's contracted beast, use the breath of humans, hide, and leave the Magic Beast Mountain Range.

Wang Shuo instantly became energetic when he heard the contracted beast.

"Who are you? Why do you want to be my contracted beast?"

Wang Shuo was still very alert.

After Bing Fenghuang explained the situation, Wang Shuo hesitated.

If he agreed to Bing Fenghuang's request, he would undoubtedly offend the Sword God, the top powerhouse of mankind, and would be hunted down by the Sword God.

But the temptation of a Star-level boss is also quite great.

As long as her injuries recover, her combat power can be said to have increased several times, and she will have a better grasp of the next battle in the outer domain.

Seeing Wang Shuo's entanglement, Bing Fenghuang became anxious.
